image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a bagel topped with sesame seeds. The bagel has a distinct toroidal shape with a central hole. The crust appears pale golden to light brown, heavily textured with toasted sesame seeds. The interior crumb is visible through the hole and slight surface imperfections, appearing dense. Other bagels are partially visible in the blurred background.
